name: Cleansing the Eye
summary: In the Wetlands, Cleansing the Eye sends adventurers south to Stormwind with a cursed orb in need of aid. After recovering the Eye of Paleth, they seek Archbishop Benedictus to purge its lingering taint.

sections.title: A Tainted Relic
sections.body: The Eye of Paleth recovered from the marshlands bears no holy light. Shadow clings to it, along with the sorrow and trauma of the tragedy where it was lost. Glorin Steelbrow, a dwarf, recognizes the orb's power. Yet he lacks the divine craft to lift so heavy a curse.

sections.title: Journey to the Cathedral
sections.body: Human priests of the Holy Light first fashioned the Eyes of Paleth, so their highest order alone knows how to undo the defilement. Glorin sends adventurers south to Stormwind with the darkened orb, to Archbishop Benedictus, leader of the Church of the Holy Light. Benedictus knows the danger of leaving such a relic unpurified. He takes on the work of restoring its sacred light.

faq.q: What is the Eye of Paleth?
aliases: what is the eye of paleth
faq.answer: The Eyes of Paleth are sacred orbs crafted by human priests to shine with holy luminance. Untainted, their power aligns with the Holy Light. Corrupted, their energies grow volatile and perilous.

faq.q: Why can't Glorin Steelbrow cleanse the Eye himself?
faq.answer: Glorin Steelbrow cannot cleanse the Eye because he lacks the liturgical craft to banish its dark affliction. Human priests of the Holy Light made the relic, so cleansing its corruption requires authority from that tradition.
Archbishop Benedictus is the venerable leader of the Church of the Holy Light. He resides in Stormwind's Cathedral of Light and guides the Alliance in matters of faith.

faq.q: Why is the Eye described as soiled or sorrowful?
faq.answer: Archbishop Benedictus says the orb bore witness to a great tragedy in the Wetlands. It absorbed that agony over time, and its lingering sorrow became a curse that warped its power.

faq.q: What happens once Benedictus receives the orb?
faq.answer: Benedictus agrees to purify the orb. The Eyes of Paleth are meant to shine brightly, and their taint brings grave spiritual and physical danger to those nearby.

faq.q: Where is the Cathedral of Light located?
faq.answer: The Cathedral of Light stands in Cathedral Square, in Stormwind City's northern district. Archbishop Benedictus stands at the main altar in the heart of the sanctuary.

angles.text: For priests of the Holy Light, the Cursed Eye of Paleth shows how despair can corrupt sacred craft. Archbishop Benedictus's purification is needed to cleanse it.
Paladins see reclaiming holy relics from dark marshes as a solemn duty. The Eye's corruption is an affront to be cleansed in Stormwind's hallowed halls.
The dwarven outposts of the Wetlands and Stormwind's spiritual leaders work together through shared faith, binding the Alliance's kingdoms.
